text.heroSubtitle: Professional Kathak courses for Indian and international students – beginner to advanced, online and at the Kendra.
text.aboutText: Sangeet Manjari Kala Kendra is a home for Kathak, the storytelling dance of North India. We offer professional Kathak courses at beginner, intermediate and advanced level for Indian and international students – online and at the Kendra in Jaipur. Teaching follows the guru–shishya way: footwork, spins, gestures and expression, with the music and taal behind them.
text.guruBio: Akshita Sharma – Doordarshan B Grade Kathak artist, disciple of Guru Shri Jay Karan Kawa Ji and Guru Dr. Swati Agarwal, with Visharad, Nipun and Bhaskar in Kathak.
text.upcomingEvents: Shows, festivals and programmes coming up at and around the Kendra.
text.coursesIntro: Diploma and Advanced Diploma courses of Bhatkhande Sangeet Vidyapeeth and Pracheen Kala Kendra.

guru.name: Akshita Sharma
guru.title: Founder & Kathak Guru
guru.bio: Akshita Sharma is a Kathak artist from Jaipur and a B Grade artist of Doordarshan Kendra, Jaipur. She learnt Kathak from Guru Shri Jay Karan Kawa Ji and Guru Dr. Swati Agarwal, and holds Visharad and Nipun in Kathak from Bhatkhande Sangeet Vidyapeeth and the Bhaskar advanced diploma from Pracheen Kala Kendra. She performs regularly on stage in Jaipur, including Nrityam and Bharat Utsav at Jawahar Kala Kendra. She founded Sangeet Manjari Kala Kendra to teach Kathak in a structured, traditional way – building both technique and understanding – and prepares students for diploma examinations.

courses.title: Kathak – Beginner Level
courses.desc: Foundations of Kathak – tatkar, hastak, basic chakkar and the first taals.

courses.title: Kathak – Intermediate Level
courses.desc: Longer compositions, layakari and abhinaya, with stage pieces.

courses.title: Kathak – Advanced Level
courses.desc: Advanced repertoire and preparation for diploma examinations and performance.
